title: Relative clauses in context
subtitle: Follow antecedent, case, and clause boundary.
overview: A relative pronoun agrees with its antecedent in gender and number, but its case comes from its own clause.
Bracket the relative clause and identify the role of the pronoun inside it before translating.

sections.title: Agreement versus function
rows: the man to whom I give
the city in which I remain

items.grc: μακάριοι οἱ ἀκούοντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ φυλάσσοντες.
items.en: Blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it.

items.grc: ὃς ἂν πιστεύσῃ εἰς αὐτὸν οὐκ ἀπόληται.
items.en: Whoever believes in him may not perish.
